text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's so bright outside. It must be<n>morning already...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I fell asleep. I'd best<n>get ready. I'll
just take care of any<n>unfinished calculations with
the rest<n>of my homework tonight—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh... How unsightly of me. I knew Ishould have gone to sleep earlier...Well, it's too late now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'd better keep it together in front of<n>Trainer.

Too absorbed in her thoughts, Biwa<n>Hayahide
hasn't gotten a good<n>night's rest.
